place_text: Edwards Air Force Base, California (also said Alamogordo)

as_told.title: Eisenhower's 1954 alleged alien meeting at Edwards AFB
as_told.place_text: Palm Springs / Edwards Air Force Base, California

plain: This story claims that Dwight Eisenhower, US president in the 1950s, was secretly shown alien spacecraft. A man named Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US military site, passes on what he heard. According to Hall, on a day Eisenhower was said to be golfing in Palm Springs, he was taken instead to Edwards Air Force Base in California. There were no cameras and no press, Hall says, and five extraterrestrial spacecraft were sitting on the runway for the president to see. Some versions place it at Alamogordo in New Mexico instead. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it differently: he gives the year as 1954, says the cover story was a dentist appointment, not golf, and describes it as a meeting without mentioning five craft. If true, it would mean a US president personally met with, or saw, visitors from elsewhere.
